Select distinct molecule ChEMBL identifiers and canonical SMILES for compounds tested against human histone deacetylase 6. Join molecule_dictionary to activities, then assays, then target_dictionary to match the target by name. Join compound_structures as an inner join to require SMILES. Filter target_dictionary.pref_name for human histone deacetylase 6. Return columns named compound_chembl_id and canonical_smiles. Sort by compound_chembl_id.
